## Build Failure Analysis

**Solution:** `BuildDiag.sln` (3 projects: `Core`, `Services`, `Api`)

### Root Cause (1 issue)

**`Services/Services.csproj`** — Missing NuGet package `Newtonsoft.Json`

`Services/UserService.cs` uses `Newtonsoft.Json` and `Newtonsoft.Json.Linq` (lines 2-3) and the `JObject` type (line 22), but `Services.csproj` has **no `<PackageReference>` for `Newtonsoft.Json`**. The project only references `Core.csproj`.

3 errors, all `CS0246`:
| Line | Missing Symbol |
|------|---------------|
| 2,7 | `Newtonsoft` (namespace via `using Newtonsoft.Json`) |
| 3,7 | `Newtonsoft` (namespace via `using Newtonsoft.Json.Linq`) |
| 22,19 | `JObject` (type usage) |

### Cascading Failure

**`Api/Api.csproj`** — failed at `ResolveProjectReferences` because it has a `<ProjectReference>` to `Services.csproj`, which failed to compile. **Api has no errors of its own.**

### Fix

Add the missing package reference to `Services/Services.csproj`:

```xml
<ItemGroup>
  <PackageReference Include="Newtonsoft.Json" Version="13.0.3" />
</ItemGroup>
```

This single change resolves all 3 errors and unblocks both `Services` and `Api`.
